examples.title: Spin selected
examples.description: Rotate at one radian per second using engine delta.

examples.title: Move while W held
examples.description: Hold W to move along parent -Z at two units per second.

examples.title: Space toggles visibility
examples.description: Press Space to hide/show the selected object.

examples.title: Tint selected mesh
examples.description: Set the mesh green on start without recoloring shared objects.

examples.title: Set camera projection
examples.description: Set perspective FOV to 35 degrees and clipping to 0.1–100 on start.

examples.title: Spawn box on start
examples.description: Spawn a box two world units right of the selected anchor on start. Stop cleans it up.

examples.title: Space spawns, D deletes
examples.description: Press Space to spawn one sphere beside the anchor; D deletes it. Delete before spawning again; Stop cleans up.

examples.title: Set light intensity
examples.description: Set light intensity to 2 and white color on start.

examples.title: Highlight on hover
examples.description: Turn the mesh yellow while the mouse is over it and blue again when it leaves.

examples.title: Click to copy
examples.description: Each click on the mesh adds a copy beside it (up to 8). Stop removes the copies.
